parsed.post: The 0.922770 run trained on shard 10, which is also the evaluation shard; that leaks validation data and makes the result invalid. Keep TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' for valid comparisons.
parsed.description: Test a modestly higher matrix learning rate with training restricted to non-validation shards.
parsed.report_to_operator: The latest experiment used TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' while EVAL_SHARD=10, so its validation score is contaminated by training on the evaluation shard. I am discarding that result.
